description: This file defines custom exception classes for the PyTorch Inductor runtime caching system, establishing a hierarchy of exception types used throughout the caching module.

classes.name: CacheError
classes.description: Base class for all caching-related errors.

classes.name: SystemError
classes.description: Base class for system-level caching errors, inherits from CacheError and RuntimeError.

classes.name: LockTimeoutError
classes.description: Error raised when a lock operation times out, inherits from SystemError.

classes.name: FileLockTimeoutError
classes.description: Error raised when a file lock operation times out, inherits from SystemError.

classes.name: UserError
classes.description: Base class for user-facing cache errors that also inherit from TypeError.

classes.name: KeyEncodingError
classes.description: Error during cache key encoding operations.

classes.name: ValueEncodingError
classes.description: Error during cache value encoding operations.

classes.name: ValueDecodingError
classes.description: Error during cache value decoding operations.

methods.name: LockTimeoutError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the error with details about the lock object and timeout duration.

methods.name: FileLockTimeoutError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the error with details about the file lock object and timeout duration.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, flock: BaseFileLock, timeout: float) -> None:$/

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, lock: Lock, timeout: float) -> None:$/
